books.title: A Vaaroving kun a Zaan di Yaalaxaaf (Remover of Difficulties)

entries.name: A Vaaroving kun a Zaan di Yaalaxaaf (Remover of Difficulties)
entries.text: Tamon a mun saan di yaalaxaaf di na paazaai be wan a Nakmai?  Fakilaan: a vavisfaaruing kun a Nakmai! Naan be a Nakmai!  Naande a mun yaanakilaaing Sina, ma di nat falos a vaartulaaiing Sina!
entries.label: SWB 75
